$note: Permit story of the Ludwigsburg school (Baden-Wuerttemberg). The catalogue codes are those of the DE-BW permit catalogue the project pins, resolved through the federal catalogue it extends. Kind, trigger and owner of every condition stay in the seeder; the story only words them. All references are invented.

authority_name: Building control office of the City of Ludwigsburg (Baurechtsamt)
clock_stop_reason: Baurechtsamt asked for the revised rainwater retention layout and the parking and bicycle space proof
clock_resume_reason: Revised retention layout and space proof delivered, fire protection concept confirmed by the Pruefsachverstaendiger
evidence_note: Tree protection fence (Baumschutz) along the old lime trees on the east side, photographed from the school gate and dated

1.text: If the building permit is refused, the site is restored and the school grounds are handed back as they were.

2.text: Security for the restoration is lodged with the Baurechtsamt before excavation starts.

1.text: Before work starts, submit the structural calculations of the concrete frame and the sports hall roof, checked by the Pruefingenieur.
1.evidence_required: Checked structural calculations with the report of the Pruefingenieur

2.text: Noisy works are permitted on working days between 08:00 and 17:00 only, and not during written exams or the break times of the school; the school office is told a week ahead of loud works.

3.text: The existing trees on the east side are protected by a Baumschutz fence before any excavation, kept until completion and checked weekly.
3.evidence_required: Dated photograph of the fence in place, with the weekly check list

4.text: Before the school is occupied, the fire protection measures, the fire alarm system and the escape routes are accepted by the Pruefsachverstaendiger for fire protection.

5.text: The permit does not replace the energy proof under the GEG, the Artenschutz clearance or the consent for the road occupation.
